_meta.notes: WORTH A HUMAN'S ATTENTION - two competing sets of figures on one Summary Page. Both pages carry a large hand-lettered banner 'AMENDED '04 YEAREND'; the amendment box is Yes with 'date of report 1-31-05', signed 1-31-06, clerk-stamped RECEIVED JAN 31 2006. Office Sought holds the whole string 'COUNCIL-AT-LARGE A' and the District Number box is blank. Lines 1 and 2 are hand-drawn slashed zeros in BOTH columns. Lines 3, 5 and 7 Column A each read 36,178 inside hand-drawn ANGLE brackets (a negative), recorded as (36,178); alongside them, in the (unused) Column B space, the filer later wrote in bold marker '$54' at lines 3, 5 and 7 with 'ON HAND CASH - $54' underneath, plus an asterisked footnote: 'See 2003 FINANCIAL YEAR END REPORT - COMMITTEE IS $36,178 IN DEBT AS OF 12/31/04'. I recorded the Column A cells verbatim and did not substitute the marker figures; note that the filer's NEXT report (key 6584af90) opens at $54, so $54 is the operative cash balance and (36,178) is the committee's debt.
